justifications.PHASE_SUBSTEPS: CORRECTED 2026-09-02 (see prereg AMENDMENT A3.1). The original text claimed this was 'frozen at a CONVERGED value (10)'. THAT WAS FALSE: measured merge fraction is 0.6406 at 10 substeps, 0.9844 at 25, and 1.0000 at 50 and 200, with cross-chain separation reaching exactly 0.0000. Substep 10 is a LATER TRANSIENT, not convergence; the true attractor destroys every chain distinction. This STRENGTHENS the PHASE_MEMORY_UNSAFE verdict and changes no measured number. The reason for not freezing at the 4-substep peak stands: a stopping time is not a mechanism.
